item.title: Vincent Saluzzo
item.description: I’m a Senior Engineering Manager at Teads, leading multiple engineering teams across the Core Performance domain - campaign management, performance optimization, dynamic product ads, and CTV. With 14+ years in tech, from writing my first iOS app to leading 15+ engineers and leaders, I’ve come to believe that empathy and kindness are the most underrated competitive advantages in our industry.

item.title: Welcome
item.description:
I spent a long time thinking before starting to write here.

Not because I lacked things to say. But because I wanted to be clear on why. Writing just to write is noise. There is enough of that already.
